children: The Brazilian government has not included any revenue estimate from a 12% tax on crude oil exports in its 2027 budget bill, the country's Planning and Budget Minister Bruno Moretti told journalists on Monday.

The Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva administration introduced the levy this year to offset the fiscal cost of fuel subsidies aimed at cushioning consumers from a spike in global oil prices due to the Iran-U.S. conflict.
